rationale: Native AROS sockets require a registered pthread and its TLS/destructor. SDL DOS worker tasks resolve pthread_self to the main thread and alias its bsdsocket context. Use joinable pthread report workers on AROS; preserve other platform behavior and existing retained worker lifecycle. No simulation changes.
target: AROS native SDL3, x86_64 v11/v1 and AArch64 v1
verification: Native v11 production-linked regression creates a live main UDP socket before a real report upload. SDL baseline: foreign task aliases main TLS once, no socket/send failure, RC1. pthread candidate: alias count0, main socket closes successfully, upload completed and acknowledged by owned local receiver after6sec, failures0. All complete network-enabled target builds passed; collected log validation and patch reconstruction recorded separately.
